## Standard 2.1: the uniform rules

IMPLEMENTING.md U1 to U16 (vendored from serialize v2.1.0). All kept at 2.1.0; a rule the reference adds or tightens later lands here first.

### confirm reject on a write or measure raising is the right reading of U9 for a port with no release build

IMPLEMENTING.md U2 makes reject on a write or a measure caller misuse, asserted in checked builds; U9 says it returns false and never panics in a release build. This port has one build, always checked (DESIGN.md (a), deviation 9), so stream:reject() on a write or a measure raises, as every other write-side misuse here does. Done when: the reference names how an always-checked port spells it, and this port matches that ruling with a unit test.
